info.title: CodeCoach AI API
info.description:
CodeCoach AI: practice Java interview problems with a deterministic judge and an AI coach.

**Auth:** send `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`. Get a token from
`POST /api/v1/auth/register`, `POST /api/v1/auth/login` or `POST /api/v1/auth/guest`.

**Errors:** every non-2xx response is `{"error": {"code", "message", "request_id", "details"}}`.
Branch on `error.code`, not on the message text.

**Correctness:** pass/fail comes only from the test judge. AI feedback is advisory.

get.summary: Liveness probe
get.description: Is the process up? Deliberately reveals nothing about versions or infrastructure.

get.summary: Readiness probe (checks the database and its schema)
get.description:
Ready when the database answers and its schema isn't older than this code needs. Names no
revision: only whether the schema is current, behind, newer or unmanaged. Opens its own session
(not the request dependency, which reads content state first), so an unreachable database is a
503 here, not an error before this check runs.

post.summary: Answer a question with a required request key (the protected route)
post.description: The same as the plain route, except that `client_request_id` is required. A server that doesn't keep one answer per key has no such route, so it refuses a request sent here (404) instead of saving it unprotected: send keyed answers here, not to the plain route, so a resend can never be saved twice by a server that ignores keys.

tags.name: problems
tags.description: Curated problem library. Hidden tests are never exposed.

tags.name: submissions
tags.description: Asynchronous judging jobs and attempt history

tags.name: ai coach
tags.description: Progressive hints, structured code reviews, budgets and history

tags.name: interviews
tags.description: Timed mock interviews with an AI interviewer and rubric feedback

tags.name: content quality
tags.description: Content metadata and trust labels, issue reports, and admin triage (corrections, retirement). Admin routes answer 404 to everyone who isn't an admin.

tags.name: onboarding
tags.description: The optional first-session introduction: the learner's choices about it and a real starter activity for their career. Records no answer text and no practice progress.

tags.name: stories
tags.description: The story bank: your own STAR stories, private to you, with every saved version kept. Writing help is built-in rules (never AI) and changes nothing until you accept it.

tags.name: applications
tags.description: A private tracker of real applications as you record them: stages with history, interview events with exact times, links to targets and stories. Nothing is sent or submitted.

tags.name: schedule
tags.description: Existing activities on dates and times you choose, in your time zone, with .ics files. Scheduling isn't doing; nothing is sent, and reminders exist only inside an open tab.

tags.name: drills
tags.description: Short communication drills with career-aware prompts. Feedback describes what's in the learner's words; measurements are only what was measured; nothing rewards speed.

tags.name: whiteboard
tags.description: System-design practice with a small, plain-text diagram: drafts with conflict-safe saves, attempts frozen with their prompt and rubric versions, and feedback that names the elements it found.

tags.name: backup
tags.description: Restore your own notes, stories, bookmarks and applications from a CodeCoach backup: previewed first, additive only, never trusting ids, roles or results in the file, and removable later.

tags.name: sharing
tags.description: Share a chosen answer with a reviewer through an unlisted, revocable link; collect their structured feedback. The link secret travels in request bodies, never URLs.
